text:
olivia: quick heads-up — I found a partial API key in staging worker startup logs. not sure if full key leaked or just a prefix. snippet below, can someone advise on rotation ownership? cc @sec-bot

samir: can you paste the exact line? we should grep across the last 24h before rotating anything to confirm scope.

olivia: here is the line (redacted a bit):
```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z worker-boot info Starting worker id=staging-3 env=staging API_KEY=sk_stg_1a2b3c4d... logging init complete
```
looks truncated by logger formatting — the token prefix is visible (sk_stg_1a2b3c).

maria: rotate asap if that is a usable prefix. who owns the staging service account / secret? josh is that on your radar?

josh: I own the staging secret. I can rotate and reprovision. plan: 1) revoke current token in vault 2) create new token and rewrap with KMS 3) update staging env via deploy pipeline 4) purge archived logs that contain the snippet. estimate 20-30m. any objections?

olivia: staging only receives synthetic/test traffic, so safe to rotate now. also please scrub the archived logs and notify infra-sre for long-term retention change.

samir: do we need to touch HSM/KMS keys or just the API token? short answer depends on whether the wrapped key material was exported. @sec-bot can you check unwrap/export events for the HSM key?

sec-bot: security scan: potential secret exposure flagged (partial API token in logs). HSM audit: no unwrap/export events in last 7d for key id hk-stg-04. Recommendation: rotate the API token only, do not rotate HSM root key unless further evidence. Also: create ticket for log-redaction automation. :lock:

maria: thanks. josh please proceed and post back here when done. olivia, can you add a short note to the staging runbook about suppressing env prints on worker startup?

josh: starting rotation now — steps executed: revoked old secret in vault (version marked deprecated), issued new token, rewrapped with KMS (kms-key-stg-02), updated staging secret in vault, kicked deploy pipeline (staging rollout). also purged archived log bundle that contained the snippet and ran a grep to confirm no other hits. PR with logs scrub + deployment config: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/482 

olivia: thanks — I updated #incidents with a link to this thread and added a short note in the staging runbook to remove env prints during startup.

josh: done — rotation complete at 2026-03-15T09:38:45Z, old token invalidated. left a post-rotate checklist in the PR.

maria: LGTM. follow-ups: 1) add automated redaction for startup logs (truncate secrets, remove full env dumps) 2) add CI check to fail if any commit prints env vars to logs 3) set staging tokens to short TTLs and require periodic rotation. I'll file and triage the tasks.

olivia: created ops-203 for log redaction and pinged @devex to own implementation. closing thread unless anyone sees an outstanding risk.

sec-bot: security note: incident closed (severity: low). recommend retention policy change and automated redaction rule. :white_check_mark:
